title: Make jit doc add idempotent for an existing identical link
description:
Re-running `jit doc add` with a path already linked to the issue appends a duplicate document reference and a duplicate event instead of re-pointing the existing link.

## Background

Observed while dogfooding charter linkage: the v1.0 charter was already doc-linked to its milestone, and a second `jit doc add` with the same path appended a second reference rather than updating the first. The vision-charter workflow explicitly re-runs `jit doc add` after updates ("re-running jit doc add after an update re-points the link at the current commit"), so the append behavior contradicts the documented steward workflow and accretes duplicate rows in `jit doc list`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Running `jit doc add` for an issue and path that are already linked updates the existing reference in place; `jit doc list` shows one entry for that path afterwards.
- [hard] REQ-02: The idempotent re-add records the refresh in the event log as an update, not a second add.
- [hard] REQ-03: Adding a genuinely new path still appends a new reference, and a regression test covers both behaviors.
